purpose: Single-channel loss ablation and gradual physical pruning of the first decoder width
selection: Rank 200 channels by masked-MAE increase when individually zeroed at the input of the second decoder pointwise layer, using training samples only. Lower increases removed first; tie by index. Test widths 192, 184, 176, each independently from the original using this fixed ranking; this is a gradual width sweep, not iterative rescoring.
recovery: One epoch, Adam 1e-5, batch size 1, seed 42, BN evaluation mode, matched unpruned control; tune on the separate two-scene group.
limits: Scores are single-channel not joint ablations; subset is small and locally correlated. Tuning scenes and final evaluation scene identities may overlap in content; no Orin latency claim.
